description: Secret, rare and hidden cars from launch-week guides, with a pin on Rockstar's official Leonida map. Each car has a precision: exact (an interactive-map marker or mapped place), street (a street or landmark named by guides) or area (district only). Pins are converted from community-map game coordinates and are good to about 1 to 2 percent of the map (15 to 30 map pixels). Every row names its sources.

map.imageCredit: Map: Rockstar Games. Official Leonida map poster from rockstargames.com/VI/media (Leonida Map & Cover Art Poster). © Rockstar Games / Take-Two Interactive.
map.imageAlt: Rockstar's official map poster of the State of Leonida, showing its five counties, the Keys in the south, Vice City on the east coast and a lettered grid.
map.source: Rockstar Games, "Leonida Map & Cover Art Poster", standard (screen) version, 2,805 x 3,840 px, downloaded from https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/media/artwork-wallpapers on 20 November 2026 and resized to 1,402 x 1,920 px for phones. Pin positions use game coordinates from GTADB landmarks data (CC BY 4.0, https://map.gtadb.org), GTA6Map.io and GTA6 GPS, converted to this poster by a fit on 11 named places and a small east-side correction.

cars.title: Twinstripe Vigero
cars.category: Standout: Street Racer (Declasse Vigero ZX Convertible)
cars.area: Key Lento, outside Brian's Lockup on Sunset Dr, next to the Isla Tropical Private Club (south-west)
steps: Go to Brian's Lockup on Sunset Dr in south-west Key Lento. It sits next to the Isla Tropical Private Club. It is the drop-off from the Lab Fees mission (door code 7700).
The Vigero is a fixed spawn parked outside the lockup. Game8, GTAVIMaps, GTA6Wiki and Dexerto all agree.
If the roof is up, smash the window to get in. If the roof is down, just hop in.
It will not start until you have the Clone Key, which unlocks in Chapter 3. Before that you can only look at it.
Nothing in the guides mentions a wanted level, an alarm or a time of day for this car.
cars.notes: Pin: an unnamed delivery-point marker on the GTA6 GPS/Gamersky map (X -2684, Y -6053) sits at the south-west end of Key Lento, which fits Brian's Lockup on Sunset Dr (LeonidaInsights names Sunset Dr, Isla Tropical and Maroon Keys there). The marker has no label, so this is street level, not exact. GTABase's map also lists the car 'outside Brian's Isla Tropical'. Set to Chapter 3 because that is when you can drive it.

cars.title: Driveshaft Hustler
cars.category: Standout: Driveshaft Famous (1932 Vapid Hustler hot rod)
cars.area: Key Lento, front yard of a big house on Dolphin Dr, just east of Jeb's Snack Bar (south-east)
steps: Go to Jeb's Snack Bar on Dolphin Dr in south-east Key Lento.
The Hustler is parked in the front yard of the large house just east of the bar. It is a fixed spawn (Game8, GTA6Wiki, The Games Wiki).
No guide says whether it needs the Clone Key, an alarm or a wanted level. Try it and note what happens.
In-game text says it belongs to Tommy O'Callahan, an elderly Key Lento local (GTA6Wiki).
cars.notes: Street level only: no interactive map I could read lists this car or Jeb's Snack Bar, and no map data names Dolphin Dr. The pin is a best guess on the south-east side of Key Lento's main town (marker area X -2520, Y -6030), so treat it as 'in Key Lento'. Every guide repeats Game8, so this is effectively one source (GTAVIMaps, GTA6Wiki and The Games Wiki copy it). Chapter 1 because no tool is named.

cars.title: Teniente Manana
cars.area: Hamlet, warehouse at the M7 Nova Auto Junkyard (near Kurt's Barber Shop)
steps: Go to the M7 Nova Auto Junkyard in Hamlet. It is an M7 gang 'illegal operation', so expect armed guards.
The Manana is inside a warehouse in the yard. GTA6Map.io marks the car at the same spot as the junkyard.
The Gauntlet Hellfire (Randy's list) is in the same junkyard, so you can plan both visits together.
No guide says whether the Manana needs the Clone Key or whether it has an alarm.
cars.notes: Exact: GTA6Map.io puts the Teniente Manana at X -2484.6, Y -3415.8 and the 'M7: Nova Auto Junkyard' operation at X -2476, Y -3409, so they match. The junkyard is by Kurt's Barber Shop (GTADB: Route 61, Hamlet). GTABase lists it under Hamlet. Chapter 1 because GTAVIMaps counts it among the early rare cars; the key requirement is not stated anywhere.

cars.title: Maibatsu '97 Penumbra FF (the green Fast & Furious car)
cars.area: Vice City, Vespucci Island (Rialto Islands), villa near the middle of the island on Neptune Circle
steps: Drive to Vespucci Island in the Rialto Islands, west of Vice Beach. KeenGamer's route: cross the bridge to Catalan Island, then the next bridge to Vespucci Island, and follow Neptune Circle to the middle of the island.

Find the modern villa behind a tall hedge with a white rolling garage gate. Across the road are a house under construction with a black sign and a white house with a big blue umbrella on its roof (GTA6Locations, GTAVibes).

Go in through the small side door beside the garage. KeenGamer, VICE, games.gg and GTA6Locations say side door; Tech4Gamers says open the main garage door instead. A Snap Gun gets you in quietly (VICE).
Breaking in sets off the alarm. Switch it off at the wall panel inside the garage (left wall per KeenGamer, far wall per games.gg), then press the switch to raise the shutter.
The car is locked: smash the window or use the Slim Jim (Chapter 2). Hotwire it with both sticks and drive out.
Register it at a Pay 'n' Spray to keep it (VICE). Registration opens in Chapter 2. Do not open the trunk unless you want a snake jump-scare.
cars.notes: Street level: every guide names the island and the villa's landmarks but none gives a house number, and GTAVibes says its own pin 'marks the island, not the exact house'. GTABase's map has a marker under Vice City that I could not read. The pin is the centre of Vespucci Island on Rockstar's poster, so it is approximate. Source disagreement: side door (KeenGamer, VICE, games.gg, GTA6Locations) vs main door (Tech4Gamers); alarm panel left (KeenGamer) vs far wall (games.gg).

cars.title: Hauners Rhino
cars.area: Goose Key, Mile Zero Air Station, rows of Rhinos in the south of the base near the big hangars
steps: Head to Mile Zero Air Station on Goose Key at the far south-west of the map, beside the town of Southwind. From Jason's house follow Route 1A south and west over the long bridges past Abismo Key (Output Lag).

Get in by the main gate, or take the Southeast stunt jump over the perimeter fence. Output Lag: take the left turn just before the main gate, drive past the guards, turn right and hit the ramp at full speed.
After you land, turn left. The Rhinos are parked in rows on the south side of the base, past a large building and fence, near the large southern hangars.
They are unlocked, so no Clone Key is needed. Climb in and go. Parking a car in front of the tank first can shield you from gunfire while you climb on (Output Lag).
Stealing one gives an instant 3-star wanted level. The main gun fires with RB/R1. Stealing one unlocks the 'Challenging Tank' trophy.
A Rhino cannot be stored in a standard garage, so you have to raid the base again for another.
cars.notes: Street level: the base is a single landmark (GTADB puts Mile Zero Air Station at X -6956, Y -6403) and the guides only say 'south part, near the big hangars'. The pin sits in the south of the base on Rockstar's poster by eye. Wanted level: 3 stars (Military Times, MetaForge). The entry routes agree across Military Times, Tech4Gamers, GamesFuze, PlayStationInfo, Output Lag and MetaForge. Open from Chapter 1.

cars.title: Hauners P-996 Lazer
cars.area: Goose Key, Mile Zero Air Station, jets on the airfield in the north half of the base
steps: Get into Mile Zero Air Station on Goose Key (main gate, the Southeast stunt jump, or by boat from the west and quietly deal with the guards - MetaForge).

Follow the runway from where you land. You pass small helicopters, then bigger ones, then a long row of P-996 Lazer jets, around twenty (Output Lag). MetaForge and Military Times put them on the airfield in the northern half, near the hangars.
Jets are not locked. Press Y/Triangle to climb in, make sure the engine is on, line up on the flat runway and throttle up. It takes off after a very short run.
Jets start unarmed. Open the weapon wheel to pick the machine gun or missiles.
You get 4 or 5 stars as soon as you get in or take off. Two enemy fighters chase you with missile locks and the jet has no flares. It does have an ejection seat.
Tanks on the ground can destroy a jet before it moves, so keep going down the runway if you see one. Jet spawns can vary between visits (GamesFuze, MetaForge).
cars.notes: Street level: landmark plus a half of the base. The pin is the north half of the base on Rockstar's poster by eye (GTADB puts the base at X -6956, Y -6403). Star count disagrees: five (Military Times, Tech4Gamers, Vice City Hustle, Output Lag) vs four (GTA 6 Notebook, MetaForge 'four to five'), and 'on entering' vs 'on take-off'. No garage storage is documented. Open from Chapter 1.

cars.title: Pegassi Infernus
cars.area: Vice City, Crosstown Police Station car park (NW 9th St), level 7
steps: Go to the Crosstown Police Station car park on NW 9th St (Sportskeeda puts it in south-west Crosstown and calls it the Vice-Dale Police Department garage). There is a gate at the entrance.
Wait for a police car to drive out through the gate, then slip in without being seen.
Take the ramps (or the small lift outside the car park, per Sportskeeda) up to level 7 and find the Infernus.
Use the Clone Key to get in. Drive to the top floor and use the stunt jump to escape the car park.
It has a tracker, so keep your speed up until the police lose you, then deliver it to Randy.
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3). Exact: GTA6Map.io and GTA6 GPS mark the Infernus request at X -856, Y 780 (Crosstown). Naming disagrees: Push Square and GTA6Bugs say 'Crosstown Police Station, NW 9th St'; GTA6Notebook says NE 9th St; Sportskeeda calls it the 'Vice-Dale Police Department car parking garage'. All say level 7. Hardest car on the list per GTA6Supercars. Trackers (GTA6Supercars/Push Square): a yellow tracker only alerts police if you stop for more than a few seconds; a red one needs you to keep your speed up.

cars.title: Pegassi Vitello
cars.area: Waning Sands, villa on Flamingo Pkwy, east of Belville
steps: Travel to the villa on Flamingo Pkwy in Waning Sands, east of Belville in Leonard County.
Hop the fence. Plant explosives on the gate for a quick getaway but do not set them off yet (Push Square).
Facing the villa, the Vitello is in the garage closest to the house, on your right (Push Square, ConsolePCGaming). Sportskeeda says the southern garage.
Use the Clone Key to take it, then blow up the gate (or fire a rocket launcher) to drive out.
Deliver it to Randy.
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3). Exact: GTA6Map.io and GTA6 GPS mark the Vitello request at X 657, Y 3772 (X 644, Y 3768 on GTA6 GPS), on the coast east of Waning Sands. Disagreement on the district: GTA6Notebook and Sportskeeda say 'southern Vinewood Beach'; Push Square, Radio Times and ConsolePCGaming say Waning Sands east of Belville. The marker fits Waning Sands. No tracker is mentioned.

cars.title: Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire
cars.area: Hamlet, M7 Nova Auto Junkyard east of Boone Speedway (Galerina St), by a red shipping container
steps: Go to the M7-controlled junkyard east of Boone Speedway, off Galerina St in Hamlet (near Kurt's Barber Shop).
Open the gates at the entrance first so you have a quick way out (Push Square, ConsolePCGaming).
Sneak round the right-hand side of the yard, keeping low, to the back. Sportskeeda says the car is near a red shipping container.
Use the Clone Key to take the car, then drive it to Randy.
Push Square says it can be stolen without being noticed. The Teniente Manana is in the same yard.
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3). Exact: GTA6Map.io puts the Hellfire at X -2499, Y -3424, on top of the 'M7: Nova Auto Junkyard' marker (X -2476, Y -3409). Naming disagreement: Sportskeeda calls the yard 'All Grade Scrapyard' on the south-east side of Hamlet; Push Square, Radio Times and ConsolePCGaming call it the M7 junkyard by Galerina St. The map supports the M7 yard. No tracker is mentioned.

cars.title: Pegassi Tempesta
cars.area: Leonida north, cabin driveway near Lake Tallaloko (random Vice City tow-truck event as an alternative)
steps: Main spot: go to the small wooden cabin on the west side of Lake Tallaloko in the north of Leonida. The Tempesta is on the cabin's driveway (Radio Times, Sportskeeda, GTA6Map.io).
Use the Clone Key and drive it to Randy.
Alternative: look for a random event on NE 3rd St, Vice City. The owner is fighting a repossession man beside a tow truck. Push Square saw it around 1 PM.
In that event, threaten the owner, then release the Tempesta from the tow truck and drive it to Randy.
The event is random, so it may not be there when you arrive. The cabin is the fixed spot.
cars.notes: Exact: GTA6Map.io and GTA6 GPS mark the Tempesta request at X -1969, Y 7041 (GTA6 GPS: X -1965, Y 7045) in the far north, matching the cabin by Lake Tallaloko from Radio Times and Sportskeeda. Push Square's tow-truck event on NE 3rd St (Vice City) is shown as an alternative and is not pinned. Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3).

cars.title: Bravado Banshee
cars.area: Southside (northern), inside Sunrise Premium Autos dealership on El Joven Blvd
steps: Go to Sunrise Premium Autos on El Joven Blvd in northern Southside, Vice City. The Banshee is on show inside the dealership (Radio Times, Sportskeeda, ConsolePCGaming).
Use the Clone Key and drive it to Randy.

Alternative: Push Square found it parked outside the Sweetbay Inn on East Buckley Dr in Capri around 3 AM. ConsolePCGaming says check the forecourt late at night and try the dealership if it is not there.
No guide mentions an alarm, tracker or wanted level for this car.
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3). Exact: GTA6Map.io and GTA6 GPS mark the Banshee request at X -1633, Y -1801 in Southside (X -1642, Y -1799 on GTA6 GPS), matching the dealership from Radio Times and Sportskeeda. The Sweetbay Inn in Capri (Push Square) is an alternative and is not pinned. The 3 AM time is one player's sighting, not a confirmed schedule.

cars.title: Ascot Paragon
cars.area: Belville (north), mansion without walls, garage reached through an open window
steps: Main spot: go to the mansion in northern Belville that has no walls (Sportskeeda). Sneak up to the garage.
The garage door is shut. Get in through an open window and take the Paragon (Radio Times, Sportskeeda, ConsolePCGaming).
Use the Clone Key. It has a tracker, so drive fast to Randy.
Alternative: Push Square found it parked outside The Banana Hole Main Bar on Shore Dr, Ocean Beach, around 6 PM. If the kerb is empty, ConsolePCGaming says try Belville.
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3). Exact: GTA6Map.io and GTA6 GPS mark the Paragon request at X -1624, Y 3502 (GTA6 GPS: X -1630, Y 3503) in northern Belville, matching Radio Times and Sportskeeda. The Banana Hole spot (Push Square, ConsolePCGaming first lead) is an alternative and is not pinned (no map data names Shore Dr's bars). Tracker per Push Square.

cars.title: Piccia Furia
cars.area: Peacock Estates, yellow waterfront villa with a detached garage on Palladia Ln (southern tip)
steps: Go to the villa on Palladia Ln at the southernmost corner of Peacock Estates. Sportskeeda calls it a yellow villa with a detached garage.
Skip the gate. Take the path on the left and hop the hedge so you are between the water and the garage on your right.
Go through the garage door. The car is inside.
Use the Clone Key, raise the garage shutters and escape through the gates to Randy (Push Square, ConsolePCGaming).
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3). Exact: GTA6Map.io and GTA6 GPS mark the Furia request at X -1094, Y -2780 (GTA6 GPS: X -1100, Y -2778), matching the 'southernmost corner of Peacock Estates' (Sportskeeda). No tracker or alarm is mentioned.

cars.title: Pegassi Toros
cars.area: Tequesta Retreat, outside the Pegassi Residences entrance on Bayside Dr
steps: Go to the entrance of Pegassi Residences on Bayside Dr, Tequesta Retreat. Push Square found the Toros parked outside in the early evening (about 6:30 PM).
ConsolePCGaming says check the street directly outside the entrance. The entrance is not a guaranteed spawn.
There is some security around, so be careful. The Toros is an SUV, not a sports car.
Use the Clone Key and make a quick getaway to Randy.
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3). Street level: no map marks this car. The pin is the middle of the two Pegassi Residences towers (GTADB: North Tower X 2, Y -956; South Tower X 48, Y -1081), so it is approximate. The Ultimate Edition '95 Cheetah is in the same building's underground car park.

cars.title: Pfister Growler
cars.area: Ocean Beach, multi-storey car park on Fig St
steps: Go to the multi-storey car park on Fig St, Ocean Beach. Push Square found the Growler there around 5 PM.
Check the parking spaces inside the car park, not the kerb along Fig St (ConsolePCGaming).
Use the Clone Key and drive it back to Randy. Push Square had no issues with this one.
This stop and the Paragon on Shore Dr fit into the same search run (ConsolePCGaming).
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3). Street level: only Push Square, ConsolePCGaming and Radio Times (via GTA6Supercars) place it, with no map marker anywhere. I found no map data naming Fig St, so the pin is a rough point on the Ocean Beach strip (GTADB puts the Ocean View Hotel on Shore Dr at X 1960, Y 639), nudged so it does not cover the Stanier pin. The 5 PM time is one player's sighting.

cars.title: Mamba GT
cars.category: Randy's Wish List (added by a mission)
cars.area: Vice Beach, mansion on the southern side of Leaf Links
steps: The car is added to Randy's list by the mission '¡Dale Mamba!' once you have delivered some of the other cars.
Go to the mansion on the southern side of Leaf Links, Vice Beach. It has a full security detail, so keep low. Take the path on the right.
The car is behind the building on the right, but you need its key. The Clone Key will not start this classic (ConsolePCGaming).
Go into the main building behind the pool, using the Snap Gun on the doors.
The key is in a bowl on a table behind the sofa in the foyer. Take it, get back to the car and escape to Randy.
cars.notes: Area level: guides only say 'mansion in Leaf Links' and ConsolePCGaming adds 'southern side'. No map marks it. The pin is the south side of the Leaf Links island on Rockstar's poster, placed by eye (GTADB puts the Leaf Links Golf Club at X 712, Y 2295), so it is approximate. Needs the Snap Gun (Chapter 3 per GTA6Notebook). Push Square says the car has a tracker and handles awkwardly. Returning it also unlocks Pay 'n' Spray registration for Advanced Tracker cars (ConsolePCGaming).

cars.title: Granforma Zorrusso
cars.category: Randy's Wish List (also a story car)
cars.area: Ocean Beach, first floor (east side) of the Hathaway Apartments car park, south along the beach
steps: Chapter 3, after Randy's call following 'Crosstown Traffic': go to the Hathaway Apartments car park in Ocean Beach, south along the beach (Sportskeeda).
Jump over the eastern wall into the car park. The Zorrusso is on the first floor in the eastern corner (Sportskeeda, ConsolePCGaming: east side of the ground level).
Install the Key Cloner when your phone prompts you, take the car and deliver it to Randy at Leonida Auto World.
It is a story car: the mission 'Steal the Zorrusso for Randy' gives you the Key Cloner and counts as the first car on the list.
cars.notes: Exact: GTA6Map.io and GTA6 GPS mark the Zorrusso request at X 2025, Y 116 (GTA6 GPS: X 2027, Y 117), south of the Ocean Beach hotel strip. 'First floor' (Sportskeeda, Radio Times) vs 'ground level' (ConsolePCGaming) is the same level. Pays $21,250 with a $10,000 clean-delivery bonus (ConsolePCGaming).

cars.title: Invetero Coquette D10
cars.area: Wasman Island, Chatfield construction yard on the western docks, beside a red shipping container
steps: Go to the western docks on Wasman Island and find the storage area with the blue fence (Sportskeeda), which ConsolePCGaming calls the Chatfield construction yard.
If the gate is shut, climb over the fence (Sportskeeda: the left side) and use the stacked containers to get inside.
The yellow Coquette D10 is parked near the water beside a red shipping container. The purple car inside a container is a different vehicle.
Use the Clone Key and follow the delivery objective back to Randy.
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3). Exact: GTA6Map.io and GTA6 GPS mark the Coquette D10 request at X 110, Y 332 (GTA6 GPS: X 103, Y 330), about 560 m west of the Waxman Island marker, matching 'western docks'. Some guides spell it 'Waxman'; the poster says Wasman. No tracker is mentioned.

cars.title: Truffade Thrax
cars.category: Randy's Wish List (final car on the list)
cars.area: Dalton Island, big car park near the back of the Dalton Island Club (ferry from Wasman/Waxman Island)
steps: Deliver every other car on Randy's list first. Randy then calls you about the Thrax.
Take the ferry from Waxman (Wasman) Island to Dalton Island and go to the Dalton Island Club, which is packed with golf carts.
Find the big car park near the back of the club. Deal with the security guard and take the Thrax.
Drive back to the ferry, going round the golf-cart roadblocks, and get on before it leaves.
On the mainland, outrun the police. It cannot be resprayed, but is fast enough that few police get near. Avoid narrow stretches of highway.
Park it inside Bayside Drive Garage to finish (Cultured Vultures, GTA6Supercars).
cars.notes: Street level: the club is a named landmark but I found no map that marks it. The pin is the middle-east of Dalton Island on Rockstar's poster, placed by eye (GTA6Map.io has the island at X 1826, Y -921 and the ferry terminal at X 1826, Y -1067; GTADB buildings run to Y -1310), so it is approximate. Single reporter: Cultured Vultures (GTA6Supercars and GTAVIMaps repeat it). Chapter 3 because the list opens there, but it comes after every other car. Pays about $18,000.

cars.title: '82 Canis Crawler
cars.area: Port Gellhorn, yard next to the old Trader's Union building on Gellhorn Ave
steps: Go to the yard next to the old Trader's Union building on Gellhorn Ave, Port Gellhorn. Moses texts the job with a map pin.
Crouch and keep quiet: people are working in the yard. Hop the wall a little way up from the locked gate and choke the man repairing the car.
Hold up on the D-pad to open WAiNK and scan the cars. The beige open-top Canis '82 Crawler is toward the back. WAiNK confirms it has no tracker.
It is locked and alarmed. Use the Slim Jim (quieter) or smash the window.
The owner shouts as you leave. Drive to Moses at Watkins Auto Parts on Calvary St.
This is Moses's first job ('Daily Driver' per GTA6Notebook). Afterwards he offers a garage north of his shop.
cars.notes: Exact: GTA6Map.io and GTA6 GPS pin this request. GTA6 GPS: X -6344, Y 4494. Part of Moses's seven Vehicle Drop-Offs in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2). Deliver each car to Moses at Watkins Auto Parts on Calvary St, Port Gellhorn (GTADB: X -6445, Y 3278). Finishing all seven gives you Moses's Emperor Sultan.

Release the Yosemite from the tow truck and drive it to Moses.

cars.title: BF Bandito
cars.area: Buckskin Swamp (north-east), Kelly County, on a dirt trail
steps: Drive to the north-eastern part of Buckskin Swamp in Kelly County.
Use an off-road vehicle, or steal a dirt bike nearby.
The Bandito is being driven along a dirt trail, so follow the trail until you catch it.
Scan it with WAiNK, then shoot the driver or call out to lure him out. Steal it and take it to Moses.

cars.title: Karin Futo
cars.area: Draper Island, Postal warehouse at the southern tip
steps: Go to the Draper Island docks, north-west of Port Gellhorn, and find the large Postal building at the island's southern tip.
It's high security, with guards wandering. Use the door on the north-western side of the building, nearest the railway tracks.
Go through the office room into the warehouse. The Futo is parked behind the shutters.
Start the engine before opening the shutters, set a waypoint to Moses and escape.

cars.title: Western Nightblade
cars.area: Ambrosia, Final Chapter motorcycle club on Birch St, central garage
steps: Go to the Final Chapter motorcycle club on Birch St in Ambrosia, Kelly County.
Climb the ladder on the left of the building to the roof, run across, and climb down inside. A hammer on the roof can take out a guard near the gate.
Open the gate first so you have an exit.
The bike is on the ground floor at the back of the warehouse, watched by a guard. Distract him with a bottle, hotwire the bike and sell it to Moses.
cars.notes: Exact: GTA6Map.io and GTA6 GPS pin this request. GTA6 GPS: X -3028, Y 3951. GTA EXP says the bike is in the central garage and PowerPyx found a way over the fence using the green container on the north side. Part of Moses's seven Vehicle Drop-Offs in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2). Deliver each car to Moses at Watkins Auto Parts on Calvary St, Port Gellhorn (GTADB: X -6445, Y 3278). Finishing all seven gives you Moses's Emperor Sultan.

cars.title: Declasse Vamos
cars.area: Lummox County, garage on Rockledge Rd just east of Grayson
steps: Go to Rockledge Rd, just east of Grayson in south-west Lummox County. Expect a shootout with the locals.
The Vamos is in a garage locked with a keypad.
Go into the main building to find the code, which is 2727.
Enter 2727 on the garage keypad, take the car and get it to Moses in good condition.
cars.notes: Exact: GTA6Map.io and GTA6 GPS pin this request. GTA6 GPS: X -5078, Y 7082. The keypad code comes from Push Square. Part of Moses's seven Vehicle Drop-Offs in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2). cars.title: '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy
cars.area: Mariana County: a Grassrivers garage (PowerPyx) / Paradise Garage, north-east Watson Bay
steps: Own the Ultimate Edition (or the upgrade). In Chapter 2 meet Wyman at the Starlet Motel safehouse and finish his Dirt Track Race at the Thrillbilly Mud Club ('Thrillbillies').
Within about one in-game day a purple icon and an Exploration task for the buggy appear in the Map Index.
Follow the task to the garage. PowerPyx calls it a garage in Grassrivers; other guides say Paradise Garage in north-east Watson Bay, close to the Grassrivers swamps and north-west of Hamlet.
Take the buggy. Claiming it unlocks Paradise Garage, where you keep it. The garage has a weapon locker and a stash for stolen goods.
Once you own it, Wyman messages you on WhatUp to start the Classic Car Collection.
cars.notes: Street level. Paradise Garage is pinned by two community maps at slightly different spots: GTA 6 Everything gives X -4088, Y -2424 (used here, 48 m from a gas station); GTA6Map.io gives X -4043, Y -2730 (about 300 m south). Not confirmed by Rockstar. It is not certain the pickup garage and Paradise Garage are the same place: PowerPyx says 'garage in Grassrivers', Leonipedia and KeenGamer say you keep it at Paradise Garage.

cars.title: '55 Vapid Stanier
cars.area: Ocean Beach, parked outside the Ocean View Hotel on Shore Dr (Shore Court garage nearby)
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Welcome to Vice City'. A purple Exploration task for the Stanier appears shortly after.
Go to the Ocean View Hotel on Shore Dr in Ocean Beach. The two-tone Stanier is parked outside it (KeenGamer). PowerPyx says roadside on Shore Court.
Take the car. Collecting it unlocks its personal garage, Shore Court Garage, for storage (KeenGamer, GTA6.house).
Collect it first: the pack's outfits, hairstyles and weapon pattern stay hidden until the Stanier is yours.
cars.notes: Ultimate Edition (paid edition) only. Street level: KeenGamer says outside the Ocean View Hotel (GTADB: Ocean View Hotel, Shore Dr, X 1960, Y 639); PowerPyx says roadside on Shore Court; GTADB lists a Shore Court Garage on Shore Ct in Ocean Beach but has no coordinates for it. The two are probably adjacent. The pin is the Ocean View Hotel. Ocean Beach pins are nudged apart. Rockstar's press images of this car are in its Vintage Vice City Pack kit.

cars.title: '95 Grotti Cheetah
cars.area: Tequesta Retreat, underground car park beneath Pegassi Residences (ramp left of the lobby)
steps: Finish the Chapter 5 mission 'Honest Abe'. A purple Exploration task appears.
Go to Pegassi Residences in Tequesta Retreat. Drive down the ramp to the left of the lobby entrance into the underground car park and take the Cheetah.
It is an exclusive variant of the Cheetah (GamesRadar+).
cars.notes: Ultimate Edition (paid edition) only. Exact: GTA6Map.io has a 'Pegassi Residences Garage' (room for three vehicles) at X 4, Y -1003, between the two towers, which fits the underground car park (KeenGamer, GamesRadar+ and PowerPyx all say the garage beneath Pegassi Residences). Not stated: whether the garage entrance is the same marker. Same building as the Pegassi Toros on Randy's list.

cars.title: Dinka Enduro
cars.area: Key Lento, driveway of Jason's House
steps: Finish the first Jason mission, 'Gone Fishing', and leave Jason's House.
The camo Dinka Enduro motorcycle is in the driveway. The Crest Kayak is behind the house (KeenGamer, GamesRadar+).
KeenGamer says the Enduro has a Chapter 1 window, so claim it as soon as it appears.
cars.notes: Ultimate Edition (paid edition) only. Exact: Jason's House is a mapped place (GTADB, GTA6Map.io: X -2354, Y -5532), and every guide puts the Enduro at the house (GamesRadar+ says 'underneath the house in the driveway').
